name: .well-known
description: Auth0 Custom Extension that serves MCP OAuth protected-resource and authorization-server metadata.
author: mustafadeel

scripts.build: node scripts/build.mjs && cd dist && zip -q package.zip index.js extension.js package.json
scripts.test: npm run validate && npm run build && node scripts/smoke.mjs

SUPPORTED_SCOPES.description: Space-delimited OAuth scopes supported by the protected MCP resource, for example read:destinations bookings:write.
